title: Custom Tree generator
description:
This Plugin adds the ability to generate custom trees for a more simple build process.
You can generate a tree from all wood types (this includes nether trees)
You can adjust the shape of the tree and the size for any application
body:
With this plugin, with a simple comand you can generate custom trees anywhere from a 10 block tall oak tree with cherry wood to a 30 block tall nether tree with pale oak.

This mod lets you customize shape size and style of your tree and generate it for any build you need

What you can customize: size, shape, style, woodtype, leaf type, number of branches, realism, 

You can even set it as dead so it doesnt generate with leaves
/treegenhelp
to find commands
